set.body: Objective: turn the declared LowRankModels.jl secondary oracle into reproducible executable evidence without treating software agreement as proof. Acceptance: pinned Julia environment and provenance; fixed-factor objective/gradient/decoder fixtures for the mathematically shared subset; shared JVM+JS fixture tests; convex frozen-decoder encoding parity; fitted-model invariant and cross-evaluation checks with deterministic starts; unsupported Huber/ordinal mappings documented; analytic and independent oracles retained; focused cross-platform and release evidence recorded.
set.title: EPIC: LowRankModels.jl differential validation for multivar GLRM
